Entity.name: Entity key
Entity.comment:
A combination of attributes and (functional) relationships whose combination of values is unique for all instances of an entity.
Keys should be natural keys wherever possible. I.e. use properties that occur in reality. Artificial keys do not help to find an instance of a thing in the real world.
Examples: Country, Zipcode Product name, version number, BOM position Product name GSC identification
